answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each paid task slot sits behind a ridge. To claim one, an agent burns twice its 30-day expected earnings — 60 tokens for a slot paying 30 — while a public beacon announces every claim. An honest agent pays once and keeps earning. A sybil forging 100 identities must burn 6,000 tokens up front, and the burned funds flow into a shared lagoon that pays for audits. Cheating forfeits the slot; the deposit is already gone.
